Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Space to learn Room to grow
Welcome to our Newton Prep community
Newton Prep combines the energy of a central London location with the kind of space most city schools can only imagine. Our pupils benefit from outstanding facilities and a learning environment that is both nurturing and academically ambitious. Here, children are encouraged to aim high, think deeply and explore widely.
An introduction
to Newton Prep
An introduction
to Newton Prep
Academic ambition through joyous curiosity
We believe in high standards without high pressure. Our passionate teachers are experts in their fields and inspire curiosity, challenge pupils academically, and help them to unlock their full potential, all while keeping the joy of learning at the heart of what we do.
A truly nurturing community-led environment
Newton Prep is a school where children feel happy, valued, and supported every step of the way. With a strong pastoral care system, dedicated teachers, and a welcoming, community-led ethos, we create a space where every child is known and encouraged to thrive.
Education that extends beyond the classroom
With a huge range of clubs, sports, and creative arts on offer across the school, we help children discover their strengths, build confidence, and develop skills that will stay with them for life.
Learning and belonging that lasts a lifetime
Our pupils go on to some of the UK’s top senior schools, but more importantly, they leave Newton Prep as kind, capable, and confident young people, ready to take on whatever challenges come their way.

Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Our vision and mission
Our Vision is to provide the children in our care with a first-rate 21st century education, in the knowledge that time is precious and irreversible. The education we provide should have a strong academic base, with an imaginatively broad curriculum for children with a range of abilities, including those with high aptitudes in specific subjects, giving a rich learning experience for all children.
The Newton education should have a lasting impact, as children progress through their school years and throughout their lives, developing their knowledge, intelligence, enthusiasm, creativity and character.
The school’s atmosphere should be full of happiness and enthusiasm, with a sense of purpose and achievement as both pupils and staff aim high, with strong management and good governance to bolster these aspirations. Our focus should be on developing the potential in each child and enabling progress to the most appropriate senior school. Newton Prep should be a model for best practice in all aspects of prep education.
My powers are ordinary. Only my application brings me success.
Our mission statement is as follows:
Established in 1991, Newton Prep is a thriving school for boys and girls, aged 3-13. The School is unashamedly ambitious for its pupils who have access to outstanding facilities. We want them to achieve their academic potential whilst also engaging in sport, art, music and drama. We want them to involve themselves in the total life of the School, which includes after school clubs and activities and a wide range of trips. We celebrate the diversity of our pupils; we want our children to develop a strong sense of community, learning how to make a positive contribution to the community of Newton Prep and the world around them. The ethos and philosophy is one that is based on mutual respect and kindness shown to others. Fundamentally, we want Newton Prep children to enjoy their precious childhood years.
Our key aims are:
To celebrate and embrace difference and diversity

Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Welcome to Middle & Upper School
In Middle and Upper School (pupils in Year 3 to Year 8) we continue to provide outstanding opportunities in all areas: academic, creative, physical, and social. We take a great deal of pride in our community and enjoy sharing in each other’s many and varied successes.
Throughout the school, you will find motivated children, enjoying their learning in wonderful facilities. We have high expectations of all of our boys and girls. The pitch and pace of our curriculum is ambitious. Our children learn to work hard; perseverance is one of our Core Values. It is our aim to provide the highest possible level of pastoral care so that each child flourishes at Newton Prep.
Imagination and Enquiry
We encourage independence and aim to ensure that all members of our school feel that they are valued and respected. By using subject specialist teachers throughout the curriculum, we fire the children’s imagination and inspire them to be creative, adventurous and committed in their learning. We promote enquiry and initiative and ensure that they are able to enjoy the many and opportunities on offer.
When pupils leave us, they go on to a wide range of senior schools, day and boarding, London and further afield. We aim to ensure that our children are fully prepared intellectually, physically, morally and spiritually, for the next step in their lives and academic careers.
We hope that you will take the opportunity to visit us to see for yourselves what makes Newton Prep such a special school and good preparation for life.

Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Welcome to Nursery
Our two Nursery classes provide excellent foundations for the children’s early learning. The opportunities for our youngest pupils are outstanding. They have plenty of outside play space, including our school garden, they have PE in the large sports hall with one of our specialist PE teachers, they learn ballet, they are taught music and they love to learn those all-important reading, writing and maths skills. They can often be seen hunting for letters, numbers or shapes around the school.
They also build their early technology skills whether this is taking photos of their friends on an iPad or playing with the Lego Coding Express train set. Some highlights of Nursery must surely be the Christmas Songs performance, the excitement of watching ducks and chicks hatch in their classroom and the very popular ‘Superheroes Week’ that culminates in a dress-up day for children and staff alike.
Children in Nursery all stay for mornings but the majority stay for full days, eating a school lunch and going home between 3.30 and 4pm. And then, at the end of the year, the children all move up to our Reception year which means they do not have to undergo the stress of 4+ assessments.

Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Welcome to Newton Prep
It is a great pleasure to welcome you to Newton Prep, a school that combines high expectations with a strong sense of warmth, community and opportunity.
At Newton, we believe that education should be both ambitious and joyful. We want every child to achieve their best academically, of course, but just as importantly, we want them to grow in confidence, develop interests that spark their curiosity, and become kind, thoughtful and grounded young people.
Ours is a co-educational environment that reflects the real world. All children learn and play together, lead and collaborate, challenge and support one another. Alongside strong academic teaching, we offer a broad and balanced curriculum, rich in music, art, drama and sport. From concerts in our Recital Hall to fixtures on the All-Weather pitch, our children are encouraged to try new things, work hard, and take pride in their progress wherever it happens.
The facilities here are genuinely impressive, but it’s the energy and attitude of the children and staff that make the school special. Newton Prep is a place where ideas flow, friendships grow, and children are known, stretched and celebrated.
We take our cue from Sir Isaac Newton’s own reflection: “My powers are ordinary. Only my application brings me success.” That message of humility and ambition run right through our school.
I warmly encourage you to come and visit us. A website can only tell you so much. Come and see the learning in action, speak to our pupils, and feel the spirit of the school for yourself.
I look forward to meeting you,
Graeme McCafferty Head of Newton Prep

Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Welcome to Lower School
The Lower School (pupils from Nursery to Year 2) is a safe, happy and vibrant place of learning where all of our wonderful staff team nurture and value every child and are passionate about providing them all with an excellent start to their school life.
Our dedicated and enthusiastic teachers use their skills and experience to provide a stimulating and engaging learning environment that encourages creative thinking and problem-solving. We believe that hands-on experiences and play-based discovery foster a love of learning. Teachers maintain a balance between support and challenge to encourage children to take ownership of their learning and to help them to develop an awareness of their individual learning styles and personal goals.
A Positive Learning Journey
We know that positive home-school links are essential to a child’s success in their learning journey and we encourage our families to share news from home and to be involved in the daily routines and events at School as much as possible. All of the staff team understand the importance of positive, nurturing relationships with pupils and their families and are committed to supporting children in the development of their social and emotional skills. Our staff team are always happy to celebrate individual successes or to offer advice or support about a child’s learning.
All our Lower School pupils make full use of School facilities and life is often busy and exciting with a variety of opportunities to explore different ways of learning. We also help our children to develop an understanding of the benefits of times of quiet and stillness through activities such as Circle Time chats and shared story time sessions.
We have high expectations of all our pupils and we encourage them to value and respect each other, to work and play alongside their peers and to enjoy their learning adventure as much as they can. We want our pupils to have fun, take risks, develop resilience, grow in confidence and independence and to transition from the Lower School ready to embrace the opportunities that the Upper School offers.

Community Partnerships
At Newton Prep, we believe education extends beyond the classroom. Our pupils are encouraged to play an active role in their local and wider communities, showing kindness, empathy and initiative through meaningful action.
Whether it’s singing in a care home, supporting local food banks or launching new partnerships, Newton Prep pupils are empowered to make a difference.
Pupil-Led Giving
Charity at Newton is pupil-driven, with our Community Captains and Charity Prefects leading by example. Their creativity and energy bring the whole school together around meaningful causes.
Recent initiatives include:
Sporting Partnerships in the Community
Newton Prep is proud to be part of a Community Sports Partnership in collaboration with Nine Elms Football Club, London Wayfarers Hockey, and Spencer Netball. These events bring pupils and families together across local schools to celebrate sport, fitness and friendship through action-packed afternoons of football, hockey and netball for all ages and abilities.
Our partnership with Newton Prep is of real and lasting value to us and to our children. We have never felt like the poor cousins from down the road. I know from what our kids and Newton Prep kids have said that there is mutual benefit and increased understanding that comes out of these shared initiatives. It has also sparked real creativity in our children, and aspirations beyond their previous horizons, as reflected in the number of St George’s children who have gone to Newton on a bursary, with our total support. I couldn’t be prouder!
Head, St George’s CofE Primary
Building Lasting Connections
From carol singing to collaborative projects, Newton Prep values the power of relationships. We are proud to maintain warm partnerships with local schools and organisations that foster a spirit of shared learning, inclusion and joy. Whether through service, sport or song, our pupils discover that they are part of something bigger and that their voices and actions truly matter.

Our History
Newton Prep opened its doors in September 1991 with 70 pupils and five dedicated teachers, marking a momentous new beginning. What started as a vision, nurtured by its Chairman and Founder, Dr Farouk Walji, has blossomed into one of the largest prep schools in the UK. Our first Headmaster was Jim Cussell, followed by Richard Dell (1993-2006), Nicholas Allen (2006-2013), and Alison Fleming (2013-2025), before Graeme McCafferty took up the post in September 2025.
We want children to develop good learning habits, to realise that success comes from hard work or in the words of Sir Isaac Newton: ‘My powers are ordinary. Only my application brings me success.’ Underpinning all of this, we want children to be decent and kind to each other. We want them to respect difference; to be tolerant and kind; to celebrate the successes of others; to show compassion for those in need. These values drive our school.
The foundation of Newton Prep was a true labour of love, and its constant evolution over the past three decades continues to be guided by Dr Walji’s enduring commitment. We celebrate this remarkable journey of growth, care, and guidance that has shaped Newton Prep into the thriving educational institution it is today, deeply rooted in the heart of London.

Nursery & Reception Curriculum
Our Early Years team set up a wide variety of activities, both inside and outside the classroom, and these provide opportunities for the children to engage in whole class, small group and individual activities which are tailored to their learning needs.
We adapt our teaching to respond to the children’s interests and abilities. Each child’s learning journey is tracked through observations, assessments and notes and planning is reviewed on a daily basis to ensure the best opportunities are offered for every child’s development.
The curriculum is planned around topic themes, but is flexible so that it can reflect the interests of the children and their families. We incorporate cultural and religious festivals that are of significance to our families, and staff are always keen to celebrate significant events in a child’s life such as the birth of a sibling, a holiday or moving house.
Room to Grow
The children in EYFS (Nursery and Reception) have an exceptional start at Newton Prep because of the advantage of being part of a large community. This means that the children enjoy using the school garden, front playground, All Weather Pitch, sports halls and dance studios to develop their skills, and children are taught physical education, music and ballet (Nursery) by specialist staff.

Open Day
Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Leavers' Destinations
We take pride in the quality of the guidance we offer parents when it comes to choosing a senior school. Our Deputy Head Years 6-8, Sarah Hales, whose main focus is to support and navigate children and parents through the transfer processes, ensures that we find the right senior school for every child.
There is no doubt that the pressure on places at independent senior schools has increased in recent years. Therefore, the advice to parents begins formally in the Spring Term of Year 5 with a general meeting, followed by the opportunity for a one-to-one meeting to discuss your child and make a plan for their next steps. This meeting is the start of continued communication between parents and the school until they begin their senior school journey.
2026 results:
Pupils at Newton Prep have secured an impressive 221 offers from 38 destination schools, alongside 29 scholarships recognising achievement across a range of disciplines. These outcomes reflect not only strong academic preparation, but also the care taken to ensure that each child is supported in finding the school that is right for them. From highly selective London day schools to leading UK boarding schools, this year’s destinations demonstrate both breadth and ambition. As ever, our focus is on guiding every pupil towards a pathway where they will thrive academically, personally and beyond the classroom, with each offer representing an individual journey shaped by strengths, interests and aspirations. We are proud of all our pupils for the commitment and resilience they have shown throughout the process, and grateful to our staff for their expertise and support in helping each child achieve their goals.

Join us for our Annual Open Day on Saturday 3rd October and meet our Head, Mr McCafferty. We can’t wait to welcome you on one of our tours!
Our Facilities
At Newton Prep, we are proud to offer exceptional facilities that support and enrich our dynamic curriculum. From state-of-the-art science laboratories and well-equipped ICT suites to inviting, well-stocked libraries, our learning spaces are designed to inspire curiosity, creativity and a love of learning in every pupil.
To go alongside our spacious classrooms, each of which has a fully interactive whiteboard or TV, we have three science laboratories which demonstrate our hands-on “do, not just study” approach to the teaching of science. This approach allows our pupils to experience science to its fullest extent, undertaking experiments and investigations often. Children from Year 3 onwards have their science lessons in one of the labs. Each laboratory is equipped with a collegiate-style area of tiered seating for demonstration and teaching purposes as well as modular benches for practical work.
In order to support our aim of instilling a love of language and literature in all Newton Prep pupils, we have two libraries, one each for the Upper and Lower Schools, and two dedicated librarians who regularly update the catalogue of over 20,000 books. Our libraries are wonderfully inviting spaces for our pupils to explore new worlds; children love to come into the libraries either during their timetabled lessons or at break or lunch times.
We have a fantastic Makerspace, three ICT suites, each equipped with fully networked PCs for whole class computing lessons and for use in other subjects when required. In addition to this, we have multiple class sets of iPADs, ChromeBooks and laptops which are used as invaluable teaching and learning resources across the full range of the curriculum.
Creative facilities
Our pupils are lucky to be able to study Art in two fully-equipped and spacious Art Studios. We have two specialist art teachers and an Art Teaching Assistant. The children can work on large-scale projects and they use a variety of media. Children’s artwork is displayed around the school, as we are keen to celebrate and profile their creative work.
Our Auditorium, which seats over 300 people, provides a superb space for whole school assemblies, plays, concerts and visiting speakers. The Recital Hall is a more intimate venue, seating 120, and is used for choir, instrumental and poetry recitals, as well as smaller-scale concerts. Both spaces are used regularly by our pupils. They enhance the children’s educational experience of Drama and Music in particular. In addition, we have two large bespoke Music Rooms, a Music Technology Suite, equipped with a number of Macs, thirteen small Music Practice Rooms, which are used for individual music lessons, and a Drama Studio.
Sports facilities
At Newton Prep we have a large, 70m x 40m, floodlit All Weather Astroturf Pitch, which can be split into a variety of different spaces, including two 7-a-side football or hockey pitches and four full-size netball courts.
This means that we do not have to ‘bus’ the children to other sporting venues, which can eat into valuable lesson time.
Inside, we have a Sports Hall, containing three cricket nets and a bespoke gymnastics hall (including wall bars and air track). There is an additional multi-activity hall, a Dance Studio and a Physical Health Zone (used by our oldest pupils), complete with rowing machines, treadmills and bikes.
Our All-Weather Astroturf pitch is available to hire for regular block booking sessions or one-off sessions during the evenings, weekends and school holidays.
We encourage bookings in advance due to limited availability. To book a session or make a general enquiry please contact our team at: lettings@newtonprep.co.uk

Join our team
Here's where we add to our most valuable resource: our staff. Generous pay and conditions, fantastic facilities and the chance to work in our colourful capital: these are the starting points for why our staff come to work at Newton Prep.
Newton Prep is a true school of London: diverse, bustling, busy in its quest for excellence and always striving to be ahead of the curve. It is also a happy place: a community of kindness and inclusion.
We want to attract teachers and administrators who aren’t just committed to being the best but also want to join that forward-facing community, want to be at the heart of one of London’s most burgeoning cityscapes, are enthusiastic about the opportunities that our pupils enjoy when it comes to facilities and learning, and excited about working in an environment where pupils, parents and staff alike are happy and engaged.
Generous pay and conditions, fantastic facilities and the chance to work in a wonderful community: these are the starting points for why our staff come to work at Newton Prep. But there’s so much more to us than that… which is why we aim to recruit, reward and retain the best.
Safer Recruitment
Newton Prep is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Applicants will be required to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post, including checks with past employers and the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS). Please see our Recruitment, Selection and Disclosure Policy for full details of our safer recruitment procedures.

Staff benefits
School pension contribution:
Teachers will automatically be enrolled into the School’s flexible Defined Contribution pension scheme with the Aviva Pension Trust for Independent Schools (APTIS). Associated benefits include group life cover and group income protection. Administrative staff will be enrolled automatically the School’s Standard Life Pension Scheme (the Scheme). If you do not wish to be a member of the Scheme you may choose to opt out.
Fee remission
A discount of up to 50% is given on school fees for children attending Newton Prep (subject to satisfying the School’s admission criteria).

Our exceptional team of staff
At Newton Prep, we are proud to be a vibrant and forward-thinking school with high expectations for every child, from age 3 through to 13. Our large and committed team, across teaching and administration, works tirelessly to ensure every pupil thrives.
We believe in education in the broadest sense; where academic ambition goes hand in hand with enjoyment, creativity and personal growth. Our staff are passionate about providing an exceptional experience for every child, in a culture built on trust, honesty and mutual respect.

Year 1 & Year 2 Curriculum
In Key Stage One at Newton Prep, children flourish in a nurturing and stimulating environment that balances academic challenge with personal growth. With small class sizes, dedicated teaching staff, and a broad, engaging curriculum, pupils are encouraged to become curious, independent learners.
There are four classes each in Year 1 (five to six year olds) and Year 2 (six to seven year olds). Each class has about 20 children taught by a qualified teacher and supported by a full-time teaching assistant. The children study a broad and balanced curriculum that encompasses all areas of learning with exciting and challenging experiences. Most subjects are taught by the class teacher through a variety of whole class, small group and individual tasks. Languages, music, physical education, computing and library skills are taught by specialist teachers. From Year 1, pupils can participate in a choir that is appropriate for their voice and a wide range of co-curricular activities are offered.
Building Learning Habits
Children in Key Stage One are encouraged to select and use resources independently and to develop good learning habits and attitudes. For instance, when a child is encouraged to persevere when faced with challenge, they can celebrate their success and this builds their tenacity and resilience, which in turn increases their self-esteem and confidence. The children receive weekly written homework and a list of spellings to learn for the following week. It is expected that children read individually to an adult each evening at home.
